messages.content:
Risk: AI decision risk
Description: The risk is caused by a decision or action made by an AI system
Concern: None
Policy: Clinical Diagnosis & Treatment Recommendations

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/LOAN/LoansGeneral/LoansRegulatory/InformationRight: information right — The right to some information in some context, for example when purchasing some product. The right to full and fair disclosure of [found by 5/18 queries]
  Siblings: equal treatment right
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/OBI_0302910: prediction — a process by which an  event or an entity is described before it actually happens or is being discovered and identified. [found by 8/18 queries]
  Siblings: determination of causal adverse event, health care process, medical intervention
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/Documents/Reference: reference — source that may be used to ascertain, interpret, or understand something [found by 10/18 queries]
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/Documents/Notice: notice — announcement, communication, intimation, or advance warning of something, usually, but not necessarily, to allow preparations to be made [found by 10/18 queries]
  Siblings: indication of interest, publication, reference document
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/SoftwareAgent: software agent — digital entity that perceives its environment and takes actions that maximize its chance of successfully achieving its goals [found by 10/18 queries]
  Siblings: automated underwriting system, automated system, party

axes.rationale: The risk involves the AI system making a decision or action, which is a form of prediction.
The AI system performing the decision or action is the software agent.
